input.quote: d. Use of Credit Data during the term of this Agreement. Client hereby grants to TrueLink the nonexclusive worldwide right and license to use, distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit, upload, display, copy and store Credit Data subject to the limitations set forth in and in accordance with the Non-Competition Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire or employee-inducement covenant binding Client (Mortgage Logic.com, Inc.). Targeted searches for "solicit", "employ", "hire", "induce", "personnel" and "recruit" return only an unrelated anti-spam provision (§ 7 Unsolicited Commercial E-Mail) and references to employees in the access-restriction (§ 8(c)) and indemnity (§ 12) provisions. The Client covenants section (§ 8) and the confidentiality section (§ 10) — the usual homes for such covenants — impose no hiring or solicitation restrictions on Client. The only restrictive-covenant reference is § 8(d)'s cross-reference to a separate Non-Competition Agreement, which limits use of Credit Data and does not incorporate any employee non-solicit into this Agreement. This matches our preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer), so no redline is required; if TrueLink later proposes one, we would hold to a mutual 12-month non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the services with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire.
